thought.text: The valhalla tile build is self-contained (downloads OSM PBF from geofabrik). Let me poll the background processes.

reasoning_content:
In other words, pbf-patch downloads the Schelswig-Holstein OSM PBF (about 50MB) from geofabrik. After that, generate-valhalla creates the tiles. This is all self-contained and only requires network. It might take a few minutes.

Let's check the remaining steps of pbf-patch and check on the progress of pnpm install. Also, let's keep in mind the total time for the build. Alright, let's wait a bit and then check the status of all the background processes.

action.command: echo "=== pulls ==="; tail -8 /tmp/pulls.log; echo; echo "=== pnpm ==="; tail -6 /tmp/pnpm-install.log; echo; echo "=== cargo procs ==="; ps aux | grep "cargo install" | grep -v grep | wc -l
